svg.aria-label: A Windows desktop with Excel and Word open, covered edge to edge by small translucent stars in many colours: Enso Retreat's break screen.

text.font-family: Calibri Light, Segoe UI Light, sans-serif
Calibri Light, Segoe UI Light, Segoe UI, sans-serif

g.text: Revenue grew 12% over the previous quarter, driven mostly by the
northern and western regions. Support tickets fell for the third
quarter in a row, and the new onboarding flow cut the average
setup time from two days to under five hours.
Two new enterprise customers signed in August.
Churn is down to 1.8%, the lowest since 2023.
The Berlin office opened on schedule and under budget.
Hire three support engineers before the end of October and finish
the migration of the billing system to the new platform.
